sum: Origin Investment Corp I does not have significant operations. It intends to affect a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses in the financial services, technology, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, advanced materials, and clean energy sectors. The company was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Singapore.
ceo: Mr. Yung-Hsi  Chang (Interim CFO, CEO & Director)
